summary: The contact sheet perfectly adheres to all design system rules and visual specifications: Keyframe 1 opens with the Cobalt/Lime reality check card before transitioning into the light off-white (#EAEAE6) graph-paper grid for Keyframes 2-6; Italic Editorial Serif lead-ins pair with heavy Bold Sans punch words; selection boxes with 4 corner anchor dots frame key list words ('Faster', 'Sharper', 'Effective') and rule cards; visual metaphors (3D bullseye, puzzle/brain graphic, 4-bar telemetry chart with curved arrow, and [INTRO DELETED] button) are rendered inside clean dashed frames; numbers ('4.0 HRS', '0.5 SEC', '90%', '35,000', '-50%', '+200%') feature glowing Amber (#FF9500) outer glow cards; and layout contains zero text clipping or overlap.
